hero.title: Environmental management and engineering for projects that move forward

why.title: Our expertise
why.c1_desc: We provide continuous follow-up on the project's environmental and sector-specific requirements at every stage.
why.c2_desc: We coordinate technical design, field monitoring, and regulatory management.
why.c3_desc: Comprehensive review to ensure compliance in sectors with high technical and regulatory standards.

services.title: Business lines
services.s1_l1: Design and preparation of environmental permitting instruments
services.s1_l2: Monitoring of environmental commitments and requirements
services.s1_l5: Consulting on quality, environmental, and energy efficiency management systems
services.s2_l1: Preparation and management of sector-specific permits
services.s3_desc: We assess the environmental and regulatory status of an asset or project, providing a clear technical basis for purchase, lease, or financing decisions.
services.s3_l1: Review of environmental liabilities and compliance history
services.s3_l2: Verification of the validity and scope of sector permits
services.s3_l3: Identification of regulatory gaps and associated risks

studies.title: Sampling and data analysis.
studies.i1_desc: Environmental noise monitoring (D.S. 38 MMA), occupational noise (D.S. 594 MINSAL), fauna-component noise (SEA-MMA), underwater noise, and vibration monitoring.
studies.i2_desc: PM10, PM2.5, PM1 and TSP (DS 61/2008), settleable particulate matter, process gas monitoring, on-site meteorology.
studies.i3_desc: Physicochemical water analysis and hydrogeological monitoring.
studies.i4_desc: VES, ERT, TEM, and SP surveys up to 300 m depth. Exploratory drilling, test pits, soil mechanics, RTK topography, drone surveys, and bathymetry.
studies.i5_desc: Terrestrial and aquatic flora and fauna surveys with SAG and SUBPESCA consultants, soil biology, and macroinvertebrates.
studies.i6_desc: Social risk analysis, social studies, and public participation processes (PAC). Strategic environmental assessment for territorial planning instruments.
